notes: The official Salsas Australia site at https://www.salsas.com.au/ was checked on 2026-07-05 and returned a maintenance page; /nutrition, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, and a WordPress search endpoint did not expose current official nutrition data.

Macro values below are from CalorieKing Australia pages for Salsa's Fresh Mex items, not from a live official Salsas PDF or nutrition calculator. Treat this as a source-backed fallback proposal, not an official import.

Vegetarian suitability is supported by item naming and by an old Salsa's Standard Nutritional Values allergen document mirrored on Scribd, version 4 dated 2013-01-29, which marks Mucho Veggie and core plant/dairy ingredients such as black beans, rice, vegetables, guacamole, cheese, and tortillas as vegetarian. The mirrored document is not treated as current macro authority.
Serving sizes are CalorieKing serving labels: Vegetarian Quesadilla 313 g, Mucho Veggie Bowl 572 g, and Mexicali Veg Salad 433 g.

Current delivery menus may use different names or recipes, for example Mucho Veggie Burrito/Bowl and Black Bean Quesadilla variants. Recheck against a live official Salsas source before importing into production.
Add-ons are intentionally omitted: CalorieKing has macro pages for Black Beans and Extra Cheese, but the task asked for add-ons/extras only if official macro data exists.

base_items.notes: CalorieKing Australia lists one quesadilla serving as 313 g with 543 Calories and 20 g protein. Vegetarian but dairy-based; recipe may differ from current 'Classic Quesadilla - Black Beans' naming on delivery menus.

CalorieKing Australia lists one meal serving as 572 g with 581 Calories and 13.4 g protein. Older Salsa's allergen document marks Mucho Veggie vegetarian; current menu descriptions commonly include rice, onion and capsicum, zucchini and broccoli, corn salsa, black beans, guacamole, and chipotle salsa.

CalorieKing Australia lists one salad serving as 433 g with 235 Calories and 7.8 g protein. Low protein for the app's goals; included only as a clearly vegetarian lower-calorie option from the available source.
